nodes.label: TerminalIPythonApp
nodes.desc: BaseIPythonApplication + InteractiveShellApp: parses argv, loads profiles, then initialize() and start().

nodes.label: TerminalInteractiveShell
nodes.desc: Terminal front end: prompt_toolkit session, themes, autosuggestions, kitty graphics, mainloop().

nodes.label: init_prompt_toolkit_cli
nodes.desc: Builds the key-binding and filter stack; prompt_for_code() returns one submitted cell of text.

nodes.label: Prompts / ClassicPrompts
nodes.desc: In/out prompt rendering, including the classic In [n]: / Out[n]: look.

nodes.label: InteractiveShellEmbed
nodes.desc: Drop-in embedded shell created by IPython.embed() for debugging inside any program.

nodes.label: pt_inputhooks
nodes.desc: GUI event-loop integration hooks: asyncio, qt, tk, gtk3, gtk4, wx, osx, pyglet, glut.

nodes.label: InteractiveShell
nodes.desc: Singleton core engine: user_ns, input transformers, CachingCompiler, magics, events, history, completion.

nodes.label: ExecutionInfo
nodes.desc: Immutable request record handed to pre_run_cell hooks: raw_cell, store_history, cell_id, cell_meta.

nodes.label: ExecutionResult
nodes.desc: Outcome object: error_before_exec, error_in_exec, result value and success flag.

nodes.label: run_cell
nodes.desc: Public per-cell entry: tees stdout/stderr, runs _run_cell, triggers post_execute and post_run_cell.

nodes.label: run_cell_async
nodes.desc: Async heart of the shell: transforms source, checks should_run_async, compiles and drives the coroutine.

nodes.label: run_ast_nodes
nodes.desc: Executes the parsed AST node by node, deciding between interactive mode, await support and single-expression.

nodes.label: CachingCompiler
nodes.desc: codeop.Compile subclass that caches code objects so tracebacks map to cached cell numbers.

nodes.label: PrefilterManager
nodes.desc: Legacy per-line dispatcher with checkers and handlers for macros, autocall and automagic lines.

nodes.label: TransformerManager
nodes.desc: Modern token-driven rewrite layer: cleanup_transforms + line_transforms, then split into cells and compile.

nodes.label: PromptStripper
nodes.desc: Cleans In [1]: / >>> prompts out of pasted code before transformation.

nodes.label: EscapedCommand
nodes.desc: Rewrites a leading escape char into a call: %foo to run_line_magic, !foo to run_system, /foo to autocall.

nodes.label: HelpEnd
nodes.desc: Turns trailing obj? and obj?? into pinfo / pinfo2 calls; runs before EscapedCommand so %foo? still works.

nodes.label: MaybeAsyncCompile
nodes.desc: Compile wrapper that detects await/async syntax so top-level await works in cells.

nodes.label: MagicsManager
nodes.desc: Registry dict of Magics instances by magic kind; resolves line, cell and line_cell magics and aliases.

nodes.label: Magics base class
nodes.desc: Base for @magics_class bundles; decorated methods become registered line/cell magics.

nodes.label: LazyMagic
nodes.desc: Placeholder magic that imports its module only when actually invoked.

nodes.label: ExecutionMagics
nodes.desc: %time, %timeit, %run, %prun, %debug and other execution magics (1,700-line module).

nodes.label: UserMagics
nodes.desc: Container where user-defined magics created with @register_line_magic land at runtime.

nodes.label: DisplayHook
nodes.desc: Installed as sys.displayhook; writes Out[n] prompt, formats the result and updates _ namespace.

nodes.label: DisplayFormatter
nodes.desc: Collects format dictionaries from per-mime formatters into the repr the frontend receives.

nodes.label: BaseFormatter
nodes.desc: Type lookup machinery: resolves _repr_mimebundle_, _repr_html_ and registered callables per class.

nodes.label: MimeBundleFormatter
nodes.desc: Calls _repr_mimebundle_ so objects can supply their own mime types in one shot.

nodes.label: display() / clear_output()
nodes.desc: Public API: display(obj) publishes through the active DisplayPublisher, clear_output resets the cell.

nodes.label: EventManager
nodes.desc: Registers and fires the available_events callbacks around every cell execution.

nodes.label: HistoryManager
nodes.desc: SQLite sessions table plus per-cell input/output rows; degrades gracefully when sqlite3 is missing.

nodes.label: Completer
nodes.desc: 4,000-line completion engine: custom matchers API, jedi inference fallback, dict-key and unicode matchers.

nodes.label: FormattedTB
nodes.desc: Colorized tracebacks: ListTB and VerboseTB variants with stack_data variable inspection.

nodes.label: ExtensionManager
nodes.desc: load_extension() imports a module, looks for load_ipython_extension(shell) and records it for restarts.
